“The Flying Whale”
   The sky whale swims once around the meadow every hundred years. The lights on its back are fireflies it swallowed, fast asleep.
《蘑菇村的派》\n 蘑菇村的派要用晨露和一点点月光来烤。最后一步，是对着派说一:

《团子的秘密》\n 团子其实能听懂风说话。风告诉它哪里藏着种子，它就用鼻子拱一:
“Dumpling's Secret”
   Dumpling can understand the wind. When the wind tells him where a seed is hiding, he nudges your hand with his little snout.
《巨树的年轮》\n 巨树每开一次花，就多一圈金色的年轮。松鼠奶奶说，那一圈里住:
“The Great Tree's Rings”
   Every time the Great Tree blooms, it grows one more golden ring. Granny Squirrel says each ring holds all the laughter of that year.
